Daniela Godoy is an Principal Researcher at the National Council for Scientific and Technological Research (CONICET), Argentina. She is a member of the Recommender Systems group at the ISISTAN Research Institute. She is also an Full-time Professor at the Department of Computer Science, Facultad de Ciencias Exactas, UNICEN, Tandil, Argentina.

Her research interests include recommender systems, social networks, text and Web mining.

item.title: Dra.
item.description:
Her research trajectory, developed since the beginning of her doctoral thesis, falls within the area of personalization in intelligent software agents and, more generally, in recommender systems. Specifically, it has focused on techniques and algorithms for learning user preferences to assist them in their tasks.

The research has centered on the use of various Artificial Intelligence techniques (such as Bayesian Networks, Association Rules, and Classification Techniques) to build individual user profiles and, more recently, group profiles, to provide assistance in computer-based tasks performed individually or collaboratively.

This latter topic has been her main focus in recent years, aiming to assist groups as a whole in various domains, including entertainment, social networks, and computer-supported collaborative work.

item.title: Dr.
item.description:
He have experience using Natural Language Processing techniques and Machine Learning algorithms. In the past, he have applied these techniques to short and informal texts extracted from social media to classify and extract useful information on specific topics—particularly, extracting information related to traffic incidents.

Along similar lines, he have also used these techniques for the automatic classification of user-generated content on e-commerce platforms, aiming to predict the category of published products based on their descriptions.

His most recent and most interesting work focuses on the use of mobile devices for learning about urban mobility in medium-sized cities. Specifically, techniques were applied to regulate the collection of sensor data from mobile devices without negatively impacting battery life. Based on this data, he applied learning and prediction techniques to detect mobility patterns among citizens and predict their next movements.aphy
